titleZh: 单元复习:新年第一天的电话
goalZh: 综合运用月份、日期、过去时和 be going to,在电话里讲节日、定出行日期
canDoZh: 能在电话里回顾节日里做过的事,并和朋友定下一次出行的日期

newItems.noteZh: 过去式 flew;fly to LA(飞去洛杉矶);fl 连在一起读,中间不加元音。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.zh: (1 月 1 日,伊森从洛杉矶打来电话)嘿,磊!新年快乐!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Ethan! Happy New Year! How's LA?
lines.zh: 伊森!新年快乐!洛杉矶怎么样?

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Sunny and warm, man! How was Christmas?
lines.zh: 又晴又暖和,兄弟!圣诞节过得怎么样?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Great! We had Secret Santa. Marcus loved my gift.
lines.zh: 很棒!我们玩了秘密圣诞老人,马库斯很喜欢我送的礼物。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: We had a surprise party. Sofia cried, but she was happy!
lines.zh: 我们给她办了个惊喜派对。索菲亚都哭了,不过她特别开心!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: That's so sweet! And New Year's Eve?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: We saw the fireworks downtown. They were so loud!
lines.zh: 我们在市中心看了烟花,声音可响了!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Awesome! So, do you and Sofia want to come to LA?
lines.zh: 太棒了!那你和索菲亚想来洛杉矶吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes! Sofia is here, too. Can we fly on January 4th?
lines.zh: 想!索菲亚也在我这儿。我们 1 月 4 日飞过去行吗?

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Sure! And you can come back on the 8th.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Hi, Ethan! From January 4th to the 8th? Great!
lines.zh: 嗨,伊森!1 月 4 号到 8 号?太好了!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Hi, Sofia! It's going to be sunny, about 75 degrees!
lines.zh: 嗨,索菲亚!那几天都是晴天,七十五度左右!

questions.prompt: 伊森在电话里问了哪些事?
options: 圣诞节、索菲亚的生日和跨年夜过得怎么样
咖啡馆什么时候重新开门
questions.explainZh: How was Christmas? …… And Sofia's birthday? …… And New Year's Eve?

questions.prompt: 他们定的是哪几天去洛杉矶?
questions.explainZh: Can we fly on January 4th? —— Sure! And you can come back on the 8th.(4 号去,8 号回来。)

questions.prompt: 伊森说那几天洛杉矶天气怎么样?
questions.explainZh: It's going to be sunny, about 75 degrees!

grammar.titleZh: 第 10 单元小结:月份、日期、出生和计划
grammar.bodyZh: ① 月份首字母大写,在几月用 in:in January。② 日期用序数词,前面用 on:on January 4th(读 January fourth)。③ 年份两位两位地读:2026 = twenty twenty-six;2006 = two thousand six。④ 出生用 be born:I was born in 2006 / on April 18th。⑤ 讲过去的事用一般过去时:How was Christmas? — Great! We had Secret Santa.;说计划用 be going to。⑥ 约日期:from January 4th to the 8th(从 4 号到 8 号)。发音:电话里报日期要放慢,把数字说清楚、重读。

examples.zh: 我们 1 月 4 日飞过去行吗?
从 1 月 4 日到 8 日。

examples.text: How was Christmas? — Great! Marcus loved my gift.
examples.zh: 圣诞节过得怎么样?——很棒!马库斯很喜欢我送的礼物。
